How booking works today — and what this page changes

Today, on mylandscapers.ca

  • You fill in a quote form and wait for a reply — no price indication at all.
  • A detailed estimate needs a property visit, arranged back and forth.
  • There is no instant estimate and no way to request a specific date online.

With this page

  • You see an instant ballpark estimate before you leave your details.
  • You request your preferred date in the same visit — the estimate travels with your request.
  • The property visit still happens, but it's to confirm a price you already roughly know.

For the owner of My Landscapers Inc. — this page is free

Built by York Digital as a free, no-obligation demo of what your customers could use instead of a quote form and a wait. Everything above works — try the calculator and the form. If you like it, here's the offer, in plain terms:

$249/month

Flat monthly plan. No setup fee. Cancel anytime — no contract lock-in.

OR
$30 / enquiry

Pay per valid booking enquiry only. No monthly fee, no setup fee.

The break-even math: $249 ÷ $30 = 8.3 — so at 9 valid enquiries in a month, the flat $249/month plan costs less than paying per enquiry. Below 9, per-enquiry is cheaper. Pick whichever fits your volume; you can switch.

What counts as a "valid booking enquiry"

A real person submits the booking form with a name, a reachable phone number, a service you actually offer, a property type, and a preferred date — for a property in your service area. Duplicate submissions, spam, wrong numbers, and enquiries outside your services or area do not count and are not charged.

  • This page, live on your own website, with your real rates in the calculator (you set them — the demo rates above are placeholders).
  • Every booking request delivered to your email as it comes in.
